name: Ram Kumar
summary:
15 + Years Experiences in IT infrastructure (Execution, Operations & Services) Projects. Handling State Data Center – NOC & SOC Operations (24x7), 4 Edge/Container Data center Project Managements and IT Video Security Surveillance-Integrated Command & Control Centre (ICCC).
Accountable for managing State Data Center NOC, SOC, and Non-IT operations (24*7) and implementation, delivering IT infrastructure support for 200 hosted Web site applications across 100+ clients.
Responsibility for project management domains: Initiating, planning, executing, controlling and closing managing scope, cost, schedule, and contractual deliverable, which includes applying techniques for planning, tracking, change control, and risk management, Procurement management
Leading a team of 38 members, covering Help Desk, Network Security, System & Cloud, Database, Backup, EMS, SOC, and Non-IT Data Center functions.
Responsible for Establishment of new Tier 3 Data center according to guideline of TIA942, Uptime institute, State Data Centre, Handle Cross-functions Teams (Construction, MEP, IBMS, Cooling -InRow, IT Infra, Power) Manage IT Service and Cloud Manage Services.
Responsible for end-to-end implementation of IT Infrastructure projects right from user requirements gathering, sponsor approval, building the project management plan, project team building, resource allocation, execution and project deliver.
IT Infrastructure Edge Data Centre or Modular Data center or Container Data center, blue print implementations or green field infrastructure and Brown field infrastructure related projects.
Responsible for significant, institute-wide projects, typically with large budgets and sizeable team size, focused on meeting project commitments, including communications with sponsors stakeholders etc.
Defining the project charters, developing scope of work, building WBS, carrying out risk analysis and mitigation measures for large and complex projects. Manage forecast resource requirements that includes human, infrastructure, CapEx, OpEx etc. essential to successfully deliver a project
Manage all project resources and establish an effective communication plan with the project team, OEM, stakeholders and the customer and provide day to day direction to the project team and regular project status to the customer.
Proactively escalate and resolve any project-level risk and track-level Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies raised across project tracks.
Data Center Move / Migration and Remote IT infrastructure (assessments, migration-on premise to Cloud, Cloud to cloud, Azure and AWS , consolidations, virtualization projects)
Practical knowledge of Data Center / Disaster Recover/ Business continuity(DC/DR/BCP) planning and Execution , DR Risk Management
Managed DCIM (Data center infrastructure Management), IBMS, EMS or NMS Infrastructure Operations, Network Operations, Service Desk, Infrastructure Planning, Network Planning.
Oversee all aspects of projects. Set deadlines, assign responsibilities and monitor and summarize progress of project. Prepare reports for upper management regarding status of project.
Knowledge of Cloud services delivery strategies and experience with implementations of all types of Cloud Deployment models Public, Private and Hybrid, Migration projects (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Create a positive customer support experience and build strong relationships through communication, problem understanding and timely resolutions. Escalate/assign incidents and service requests to the development and support team as required
